evidence_classes: generic Efinix-family synthesis mapping for historical IOL1 bringup

runs.scope: Current C protocol with host sanitizers; four ARM compile/link artifacts; actual C peers and four IOL1 RTL masters in the historical six-motion/two-encoder bringup wrapper; generic Efinix-family mapping.
Current checked-in structural CNC3 RTL command validation, 96/176-byte serial transport and response packing; no motion generators.
Unchanged report-local twelve-motion/four-encoder candidate; actual compiled RTL serial transport, emitted step/direction pins, ideal mechanics, encoder waveforms and serial feedback.
Four actual ABZ encoder components plus twelve-lane alarm filtering; local Z capture is not a CNC3 index event implementation.
Actual twelve-generator algorithm equivalence and separate dynamic timing/clean-drain component checks.

Actual serial transport after concurrent twelve-lane motion: six unsupported I/O/PWM/probe/index commands refuse, each of twelve alarm lanes inhibits, and each of four encoder-valid losses inhibits; serial feedback is independently decoded.

fixture_failure_retained.classification: test fixture assumption corrected; no RTL source change
fixture_failure_retained.cause: Initial fixture incorrectly required permit_out_req LOW during armed motion. The unchanged state machine defines it as armed_mask != 0. It is motion permission, not general I/O authority.
fixture_failure_retained.correction: Require output_request and progress_o LOW after commissioning during ordinary motion; keep motion permission semantics unchanged. Correct feedback decoder field names to alarm_levels and encoder_fault_mask.

remaining_gaps.detail: No adopted single complete IS-2 top combines these separately evidenced components and current firmware.

Replayed motion top lacks CAP3 READ_PAGE; separate profile candidate deliberately sets IS2_PROFILE_COMPLETE=0. Real identity, acquisition and qualification are incomplete; real host discovery refusal must remain.

24 general DI and 16 smart general DO are not functionally integrated in the replayed twelve-motion top. DI/AI are stale, and unsupported DO requests refuse. Diagnostic-only IOL1 replay grants no output authority.
No complete actual home/limit/probe/event acquisition or CNC3 index one-shot event ring. Local ABZ Z capture is component evidence only.
General output/PWM authority and complete IOL1 output application remain unimplemented; ideal external permission/watchdog providers do not establish physical safety.
This evidence does not execute LinuxCNC or a qualified CNC3 HAL integration; see separately owned host receipts.
No actual selected-device vendor place/route, pin constraints, static timing or bitstream proof; no physical signal, current, watchdog, power or machine measurements.

interpretation: Do not sum cycles, fixture assertions, static vectors and scenarios into a unique proof count.
Historical runner field actual_FPGA_integration means actual compiled RTL integration only, not a physical FPGA device.

Legacy installed_input=0xfff, class-1 and qualification_complete bench inputs are authored logical qualification fixtures; they are not IS-2 integrated-region card-presence discovery or physical proof.
Historical six-joint/two-encoder IOL1 wrapper evidence is separate from report-local twelve-generator/four-encoder evidence.
No RTL, firmware, routing, protocol limits, existing historical reports or external IS-1 archive were modified for this qualification work.
